thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-runtime pool 'pool-usw1-gpu-a'. 5m error rate = 12.3%, spike started 2026-03-15T11:03:00Z. Top errors: SIGSEGV / OOM / 502 gateway. Affected models: redwood/gptx-13b-int8 (primary), fallback 7b also seeing timeouts. Autoscaling did not stabilize. Pager routed to #incidents and @alyssa-oncall. https://monitoring.example/alert/4612345678

alyssa-oncall: I'm on it. Joining debug. Quick question: is this global or just us-west1?

incident-bot: Region tag: us-west1; some spillover to us-east1 (small). Top customer impact in us-west1.

sam-runtime: I can confirm high restart rates on model-runner pods. `kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep pool-usw1` shows a lot of CrashLoopBackOff and OOMKilled. Example from node-12: 
```
2026-03-15T11:02:57Z model-runner[pid=2345]: runtime: out of memory: allocation failed
2026-03-15T11:02:58Z kernel: Killed process 2345 (model-runner) total-vm:1423848kB, anon-rss:1300000kB, file-rss:0kB
2026-03-15T11:03:01Z model-runner[pid=2359]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8a3c2f sp 0x7ffc.. error 4 in libattention.so
```

maya-sre: Noted. Seeing eviction storms on the node (OOM killer cycles). Could be kv-cache growth + very long contexts causing mem blowout. Any recent rollout to kernel or quant kernels?

ricardo-eng: We pushed a quantization kernel tweak 45m ago to improve perf for gptx-13b-int8. Rollout showed green in canary. I'll check diff. If it's related, we should roll back immediately.

sam-runtime: I'm going to take pool-usw1 out of LB rotation and shift traffic to dedicated-fallback pools. Running: `routectl set-weight --pool pool-usw1-gpu-a 0` then `routectl set-weight --pool pool-usw1-fallback 100`

deploy-bot: Route change applied by sam-runtime. pool-usw1-gpu-a -> 0%, pool-usw1-fallback -> 100% (effective 11:04:12Z).

alyssa-oncall: Good. Sam, also please enable model fallback in routing policy to redirect requests for gptx-13b-int8 to gptx-7b-quant where latency is acceptable. Example: `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --model gptx-13b-int8=gptx-7b-quant`

sam-runtime: Done. Fallback enabled at 11:05:02Z. Batching disabled for pool-usw1 to reduce peak allocations: `redwoodctl config set pool-usw1-batching=false`

maya-sre: After routing changes, 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 3.1% in the last 2 min. Some residual 502s from gateway as draining finishes.

eva-support: Short customer-impact note for ops: ~4% of requests for customers in us-west1 impacted; top affected customers: alpha-corp (minor service degradation), beta-saas (timeouts on long-chat sessions). No data leakage observed. We'll prepare a post-incident customer status after initial mitigation.

ricardo-eng: I dug into the quant kernel diff. There's one change that touched memory allocation for KV cache prefetch (improper memset length). Reverting now. Command: `git revert --no-commit ab12f3c && redwoodctl deploy --pool pool-usw1-gpu-a --image canary-revert:ab12f3c`

sam-runtime: Rolling back nodes now. I'll cordon node-12 and drain to move pods off before deploy. `kubectl cordon node-12 && kubectl drain node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

alyssa-oncall: FYI on escalation: if error rate doesn't drop <1% in next 15m we'll escalate to full SEV and notify enterprise SLAs. Right now mitigations reduced customer impact significantly.

deploy-bot: Revert deploy started by ricardo-eng at 11:07:44Z. Tracking rollout.

sam-runtime: Logs from reverting image show stable starts, no immediate segfaults on the reverted image. Example: 
```
2026-03-15T11:08:12Z model-runner: startup complete (kv-cache size=0.8GB)
2026-03-15T11:08:15Z model-runner: healthcheck passed
```

maya-sre: Monitoring shows 5xx at 0.9% now for us-west1; overall gateway 5xx at 0.6%. Memory pressure on nodes trending down.

eva-support: Drafting a short status to affected customers: "We've identified a regression in a recent kernel optimization that impacted memory management for long-context inference. Traffic was shifted to fallback pools and a safe rollback applied. We're continuing to monitor; we have no evidence of customer data exposure."

chris-product: Please add a short note to the incident timeline for product: expected RCA and customer-facing post-mortem once we confirm root cause + mitigation plan. Also want timeline to include decision points for enabling fallback routing.

alyssa-oncall: Agreed. Next steps: 1) Continue monitoring for 30m. 2) Run a synthetic stress test on canary with long contexts to validate reverted kernel fix. 3) Prepare RCA with rollback diff and mitigations for batching + routing policies.

sam-runtime: I'll run the stress harness now against a canary pool. Command: `tools/stress_infer --model gptx-13b-int8 --ctx 16384 --qps 10 --duration 10m`

maya-sre: If anyone wants to follow logs: `stern model-runner -n runtime pool-usw1-gpu-a` and `journalctl -u model-runner -f` on nodes.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied (routing fallback + revert) — customer impact substantially reduced. Paging stand-down not requested yet. Continue updates in this thread.

alyssa-oncall: Thanks everyone. I'll collect notes and start the incident doc in #postmortems once we confirm the RCA. Leaving this thread open for next 30m for final checks.

sam-runtime: Stress run started at 11:12Z. Will update if we see regressions.
